events.title: Financial Literacy for You
speaker: Lynette TAN
events.content:
Want to get smarter with your money, no matter where you're at in life? Join us for a crash course on taking control of your finances from your first paycheck to retirement.

You will learn about the 4 Money Habits that can help you better understand your financial situation and build sustainable habits to achieve your financial and life goals.

speaker: Sharon TAN
Paige WEI
Art KAROONYAVANICH
JJ Jia Jie FANG
events.content: Don't miss the chance to hear uplifting mentoring stories! Seasoned mentors and thriving mentees share their journeys to rewarding relationships that accelerate growth. events.title: Elevating Your Growth Mindset With The Habit Loop
speaker: Him Chuan LIM
Simon ONG
events.content: In a world where everything is fast evolving and being disrupted by Technology and GenAI, lifelong learning has become a must, not a slogan. But the pace of work and life does not slow down. In face of competing priorities, how can we ensure that we continuously learn, unlearn, pick up new skills, and stay abreast of the latest trends? Join Joanne, Him Chuan and Simon in this session, where they will share with you how to use the Habit Loop, a tool built on behavioral science, to embed personal growth habits into your life.

Wenxian YEO
Kiran KUPPILI
events.content: Join us for an engaging session with our dynamic panel of experts. Through an interactive discussion, we will debunk myths and address some of your burning questions on Total Rewards. events.title: GMC Career Journey Sharing
speaker: Tse Koon SHEE
Derrick GOH
Chu Chong LIM

events.title: Mental Well-Being (Balancing and Thriving)
speaker: Bobby TENG (Workplace Options, iOK)
events.content:
It’s important to understand how to create a balanced life to avoid becoming unwell.

Learn about burnout, understand its risk factors and how to identify signs and stages of burnout in this webinar.

Find out healthy ways to protect yourself from a NLP Master Coach and Trainer, together with Jeremy Soo, SGMC member, and practise a positive well-being exercise – together - we can thrive!

events.title: Sustainability is Everyone's Business!
speaker: Karen NGUI
Peng Fong GOH
Yvonne LIM
events.content: Sustainability is the future and will be integral to all jobs. This wave is affecting all parts of economy and society. On the finance sector front, the MAS-IBF recently launched a Jobs Transformation Map, highlighting that 50,000 jobs in Singapore's financial sector will be impacted by sustainability. As the private sector innovates with eco-friendly technologies and ambitious sustainability goals, the finance sector funds green ventures, proving that investing in the planet is profitable. Communities at large are also driving sustainable efforts. Join us to catch this Sustainability wave!

events.title: Career Planning, Upskilling and Reskilling
speaker: Dennis CHAN (WSG)
events.content: Career planning is investing in ourselves, providing clarity for informed decisions. Through careful planning, we aim for long-term career sustainability. In this session, you'll learn the importance of career planning, understand your career motivators, and discover various tools and techniques to align your career goals with your personal aspirations.

events.title: Elevating Your Growth Mindset With The Habit Loop
speaker: Him Chuan LIM
Simon ONG
events.content: In a world where everything is fast evolving and being disrupted by Technology and GenAI, lifelong learning has become a must, not a slogan. But the pace of work and life does not slow down. In face of competing priorities, how can we ensure that we continuously learn, unlearn, pick up new skills, and stay abreast of the latest trends? Join Joanne, Him Chuan and Simon in this session, where they will share with you how to use the Habit Loop, a tool built on behavioral science, to embed personal growth habits into your life.

events.content: Join us for a fireside chat with Guest-of-Honour Mr Edwin Tong, Singapore Minister for Culture, Community, and Youth & Second Minister for Law, as he discusses the importance of embracing diversity, and how we can foster a deeper sense of belonging in our workplace and community.

Serene CHEONG

events.title: Sustainability is Everyone's Business!
speaker: Karen NGUI
Peng Fong GOH
Yvonne LIM
events.content: Sustainability is the future and will be integral to all jobs. This wave is affecting all parts of economy and society. On the finance sector front, the MAS-IBF recently launched a Jobs Transformation Map, highlighting that 50,000 jobs in Singapore's financial sector will be impacted by sustainability. As the private sector innovates with eco-friendly technologies and ambitious sustainability goals, the finance sector funds green ventures, proving that investing in the planet is profitable. Communities at large are also driving sustainable efforts. Join us to catch this Sustainability wave!

events.title: Career Planning, Upskilling and Reskilling
speaker: Dennis CHAN (WSG)
events.content: Career planning is investing in ourselves, providing clarity for informed decisions. Through careful planning, we aim for long-term career sustainability. In this session, you'll learn the importance of career planning, understand your career motivators, and discover various tools and techniques to align your career goals with your personal aspirations.

speaker: Tiara PUSPITA (Workplace Options, iOK)
events.content:
It’s important to understand areas of well-being and develop strategies to maintain a healthy self-care routine for oneself.

Learn about the well-being wheel, explore a range of self-care strategies and develop a personal self-care plan to manage stress and build your resilience!

Join Xue Min Hang, SGMC member at this session led by a clinical psychologist to unpack this interesting topic.

speaker: Dr Yak Sin LIN, General Practitioner
events.content: Join Dr Yak to learn about the common Chronic Diseases - Hypertension, High Cholesterol and Diabetes. Understand the risk factors, symptoms, how to prevent and the common treatments for these conditions.
